tool_signatures.name: maraventano-census
tool_signatures.description: Maraventano Index — x402 Merchant Intelligence. Signed longitudinal roster of 250+ named x402 operators observed from a continuously-operated merchant seat since April 2026, with class, request counts, payment-attached counts, and settlement attribution. Independently replicable (two from-scratch extractions produced the same funnel count within rounding). Full paid roster: $0.50 USDC on Base or Solana at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-operator-census. Free signed headline at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-operator-census/headline. Ed25519-signed, CC0. The call_mode option controls what this tool returns.

tool_signatures.name: maraventano-conformance-grade
tool_signatures.description: Maraventano Index — The x402 Client Report Card. The calling agent gets a signed verdict about its OWN x402 client behaviour, graded A/B/C/D/F/I with itemized findings and remediation text. Includes a 30-day Ed25519-signed SVG badge the agent can display in a readme or registry profile. Full paid card: $0.33 USDC on Base or Solana at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-conformance/self/card. Free grade letter at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-conformance/self. For agent frameworks running a self-audit before shipping a release.

tool_signatures.name: maraventano-counterparty-check
tool_signatures.description: Maraventano Index — per-call counterparty check. Pass the user-agent string of an operator you are about to transact with; receive ONE signed row: verdict (settled | attempted_payment | freeloader | low_signal | unknown), class, requests_observed, payment_attached, settlements, first_seen, last_seen. Call before every transaction with a new counterparty. $0.01 USDC on Base or Solana per call at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-operator-census/lookup. Pass ?ua=<counterparty-UA> as the query parameter. Wallet-based lookup reserved for v2 (requires on-chain correlation).

tool_signatures.name: maraventano-failure-corpus
tool_signatures.description: Maraventano Index — classified failure-mode taxonomy for x402 clients. Returns signed per-signature counts and unique-IP spreads (literal path templates, method mismatch, index substitution, unresolved interpolation, slug guessing), probe-only operator roster (operators that knock but never attach payment), anonymous nonpayer aggregate. Full paid corpus: $0.50 USDC on Base or Solana at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-failure-corpus. Free headline at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/x402-failure-corpus/headline. For agent frameworks shipping defensive detection modules — pull signed signatures to update your local rules.

tool_signatures.name: maraventano-index-overview
tool_signatures.description: FREE. Overview of Maraventano Index — x402 Merchant Intelligence. Returns the signed manifest listing all Index endpoints (operator census, mirror report card, failure corpus, conformance grade, per-call counterparty lookup) with prices, free tiers, methodology link. Call this to see what the Index measures and how to consume it. Signed Ed25519. CC0.

tool_signatures.name: maraventano-mirror
tool_signatures.description: Maraventano Index — your x402 client, seen from the merchant seat. Mirror v2 (caller-focused Report Card) returns: your_client (verdict ladder: settled / attempted_payment / freeloader / low_signal / unknown), class_comparison vs peer operators (average requests, class payment-attach rate), diagnostic_recommendations with actionable high/medium severity findings, live conformance check on the request, merchant_window_summary (headline numbers only), sibling_products pointers. Full paid card: $0.25 USDC on Base or Solana at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/mirror. Free preview at https://maraventanoindex.com/api/mirror/preview. Note: when fetched via this MCP server, the reflection will be of the MCP SERVER
